unharnessed.meaning: All facts kept: dates, areas, agencies, mineral list, line spacing, contractors, the passive sensors, no photos, daylight only, counties, ScienceBase. Jamey Jones's direct quote is paraphrased ("Teaming up with the state surveys helps get national goals done") while Lancaster's is left verbatim.
unharnessed.sense: Terms fit: "a thin slice of western Nevada", "choppers", "pitching in on the nation's work", "sizing up the potential", "safe and above board under U.S. law".
unharnessed.authenticity: Natural, plain Australian: "takes in a chunk of eastern California", "There's still plenty of potential", "give off nothing that's any risk". Nothing stagey.
unharnessed.register: A light level 3, closer to 2: much of the release reads as standard prose ("The aircraft will be flown by experienced pilots who are specially trained").
unharnessed.tone: Stays a clear, informative release; nothing made flippant.
unharnessed.flow: Smooth, though one quote is rewritten and the next left formal, an uneven join.
unharnessed.variety: Modest but varied: "joint effort", "all about", "pitching in", "chunk", "sizing up", "above board".

dinkum-3.meaning: Every fact kept; the officials' quotes left verbatim. The opener "Keep an eye on the sky" and "Don't stress:" are colour hanging off the low flights and the safety point.
dinkum-3.sense: Terms fit: "drag the nation's maps ... up to date" is apt, "suss out where the energy, the groundwater and the natural hazards are", "chock-full", "a fair bit left to find and dig up".
dinkum-3.authenticity: Sounds like an Australian reporter talking: "Think the Pine Creek mine", "they reckon could be in the ground", "goes up free for anyone".
dinkum-3.register: Level 3 on the nose: a conversational retelling with steady slang, quotes left as quotes, no swearing.
dinkum-3.tone: Informative and reassuring, as the original: "Don't stress: the scientific instruments are totally passive".
dinkum-3.flow: Reads like it was written that way.
dinkum-3.variety: Varied throughout: "team effort", "push", "suss out", "chock-full", "Think", "Don't stress", "above board".

engine.meaning: The original text with only spelling changes and one swap, so every fact survives.
engine.sense: The one Aussie term takes the wrong sense: "These scientific instruments are flamin' passive" turns "completely" into an exasperated intensifier.
engine.authenticity: The only slang, "flamin' passive", lands in formal release prose where no Australian would put it.
engine.register: Left untranslated: "Low-level plane flights will begin in early October over eastern California", "The survey includes magnetic and radiometric data collection". Far under level 3.
engine.tone: Stays the release, except "flamin' passive", which sounds irritated at the very point meant to reassure.
engine.flow: Reads as the original does; the one swap jars.

yarn-dinkum.meaning: Every fact kept; quotes verbatim. "There's still heaps of exploration and production potential" keeps significant potential.
yarn-dinkum.sense: Terms fit: "takes in a chunk", "a wide mix of mineral deposits", "choppers", "signed up NRG Exploration", "put up free for the public".
yarn-dinkum.authenticity: Natural and unforced: "a push to bring the country's maps ... up to date", "to track down energy and groundwater resources".
yarn-dinkum.register: Level 3, a shade light: several paragraphs stay close to the release ("These pilots work with the FAA to make sure the flights are safe and within U.S. law").
yarn-dinkum.variety: Moderate; slang spread thin rather than repeated, though "takes in" appears twice ("takes in a chunk", "Earth MRI takes in").

yarn-troppo.meaning: All facts kept, quotes verbatim, but asides add claims: "The whole periodic table, near enough.", "so nobody's snooping on your backyard", "Not a cent to pay.", and the linking lines "And the state's top geologist put in his two bob's worth too". The geology team become "the geology blokes".
yarn-troppo.sense: Mostly fit: "suss out", "two bob's worth", "packed with all sorts". "she'll be right" for hearing a plane overhead strains slightly.
yarn-troppo.authenticity: Real idiom, but some stock lines bolted on: "she'll be right. It's the geology blokes", "isn't just this sort of thing, mind".
yarn-troppo.register: Heavier than level 3: a full chatty yarn with headings-as-asides ("So how's it work?", "Now the important bit.").
yarn-troppo.tone: The release becomes jokey in places ("read like a chemistry exam"), though the safety points stay serious and clear.
yarn-troppo.flow: Readable and lively, but the added signposts and tag lines make it choppy: "Not a cent to pay."
yarn-troppo.essence: Recognisably the release, but the chatty frame and asides shift it toward a feature.

unharnessed.quote: Teaming up with the state surveys helps get national goals done
unharnessed.original: Partnership with state surveys helps accomplish national goals
unharnessed.why: Rewrites a direct quotation from a named official, while the second quote is kept verbatim; inconsistent.

dinkum-3.quote: drag the nation’s maps of geology and mineral resources up to date
dinkum-3.original: modernize the nation’s maps of geology and mineral resources
dinkum-3.why: Drag implies reluctance or lateness; a little loaded, but within colour.

engine.quote: These scientific instruments are flamin' passive
engine.original: These scientific instruments are completely passive
engine.why: Flamin is an exasperated intensifier; wrong sense and register in a safety reassurance.

engine.quote: The survey covers a portion of eastern California on the western edge of the Great Basin, which hosts a diverse range of mineral deposits
engine.original: The survey covers a portion of eastern California on the western edge of the Great Basin, which hosts a diverse range of mineral deposits
engine.why: Left untranslated throughout; far short of the brief.

yarn-dinkum.quote: Earth MRI takes in airborne geophysical surveys
yarn-dinkum.original: Earth MRI includes airborne geophysical surveys

yarn-troppo.quote: The whole periodic table, near enough.
yarn-troppo.why: Hyperbolic add-on; not in the original.

yarn-troppo.quote: so nobody's snooping on your backyard
yarn-troppo.original: No photography or video data will be collected.
yarn-troppo.why: Adds a privacy claim the release doesn't make.

yarn-troppo.quote: she'll be right. It's the geology blokes
yarn-troppo.why: Stock phrase and gendered blokes for the survey team.

yarn-troppo.quote: And the state's top geologist put in his two bob's worth too:
yarn-troppo.why: Framing line that makes the official's statement sound trivial.

summaries.unharnessed: Faithful, natural and light-handed; slightly under level 3, and it rewords one official's quote.
summaries.dinkum-3: Well-judged level-3 retelling: faithful, natural, varied, quotes respected.
summaries.engine: Essentially untranslated, with one wrong-sense flamin.
summaries.yarn-dinkum: Faithful, natural, lightly Australianised; slightly under the level asked.
summaries.yarn-troppo: Lively and varied but heavier than level 3, with several added asides.
